searchText: If a block is filled 68% then how much increase it willbe in next block ? For example this block https://etherscan.io/block/13631596 is 67.86 percent and base gas fees is set to 97.98111278 Gwei. In the next block https://etherscan.io/block/13631597 it should be around 105 gwei as per 12.5% increase but it is set to 102 gwei What is the exact formula for calculating base gas fees ? https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-1559 ```python if INITIAL_FORK_BLOCK_NUMBER == block.number: expected_base_fee_per_gas = INITIAL_BASE_FEE elif parent_gas_used == parent_gas_target: expected_base_fee_per_gas = parent_base_fee_per_gas elif parent_gas_used > parent_gas_target: gas_used_delta = parent_gas_used - parent_gas_target base_fee_per_gas_delta = max(parent_base_fee_per_gas * gas_used_delta // parent_gas_target // BASE_FEE_MAX_CHANGE_DENOMINATOR, 1) expected_base_fee_per_gas = parent_base_fee_per_gas + base_fee_per_gas_delta else: gas_used_delta = parent_gas_target - parent_gas_used base_fee_per_gas_delta = parent_base_fee_per_gas * gas_used_delta // parent_gas_target // BASE_FEE_MAX_CHANGE_DENOMINATOR expected_base_fee_per_gas = parent_base_fee_per_gas - base_fee_per_gas_delta ``` Thanks a lot. Though it looks a bit complicated but hopefully I'll dissect it -12.5% to 12.5% is the range, but it'll only be -12.5% if the previous block was totally empty and +12.5% if the previous block was 200% full. The actual change between blocks is linear between those extremes.

excerpts.author: pietjepuk
excerpts.content:
https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-1559

```python
        if INITIAL_FORK_BLOCK_NUMBER == block.number:
            expected_base_fee_per_gas = INITIAL_BASE_FEE
        elif parent_gas_used == parent_gas_target:
            expected_base_fee_per_gas = parent_base_fee_per_gas
        elif parent_gas_used > parent_gas_target:
            gas_used_delta = parent_gas_used - parent_gas_target
            base_fee_per_gas_delta = max(parent_base_fee_per_gas * gas_used_delta // parent_gas_target // BASE_FEE_MAX_CHANGE_DENOMINATOR, 1)
            expected_base_fee_per_gas = parent_base_fee_per_gas + base_fee_per_gas_delta
        else:
            gas_used_delta = parent_gas_target - parent_gas_used
            base_fee_per_gas_delta = parent_base_fee_per_gas * gas_used_delta // parent_gas_target // BASE_FEE_MAX_CHANGE_DENOMINATOR
            expected_base_fee_per_gas = parent_base_fee_per_gas - base_fee_per_gas_delta
```
